events.text: Maximilian Mittelstädt (Stuttgart) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Stuttgart 1, Atletico Madrid 0. Jamie Leweling (Stuttgart) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner.
First Half ends, Stuttgart 1, Atletico Madrid 0.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Ademola Lookman replaces Jonathan David.
Second Half begins Stuttgart 1, Atletico Madrid 0.
Goal! Stuttgart 1, Atletico Madrid 1. Julián Alvarez (Atletico Madrid) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Ademola Lookman.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Lorenz Assignon replaces Josha Vagnoman because of an injury.
Morten Hjulmand (Atletico Madrid) is shown the red card.
Delay in match because of an injury Angelo Stiller (Stuttgart).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Johnny Cardoso replaces Álex Baena.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Ermedin Demirovic replaces Jamie Leweling.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Obed Vargas replaces Julián Alvarez.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Robin Le Normand replaces Pablo Barrios.
Substitution, Atletico Madrid. Alexander Sørloth replaces Giuliano Simeone.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Dzenan Pejcinovic replaces Deniz Undav.
Substitution, Stuttgart. Leo Sauer replaces Chris Führich.
Second Half ends, Stuttgart 1, Atletico Madrid 1.
